name: qa_head_reviews
description: Fetch the reviews whose commit_id is exactly this head SHA. Returns a JSON array of {author, state, submitted_at, carries_verdict_line} — an empty array means no review has ever ruled on this head. Review bodies are NOT returned; carries_verdict_line is the fact that a body carries a `VERDICT: pass` or `VERDICT: block[...]` line. This is the only read that names the head a review ruled on: `reviewDecision` and `mergeStateStatus` are PR-level states that survive a force-push (mika#2934). A missing or malformed field is an error, never an empty array.

repo.description: owner/name, exactly as the webhook names it (e.g. senara-solutions/mika)

pr.description: the PR number the check_suite names

head_sha.description: the check_suite's head SHA — 40 lowercase hex characters, already in hand from the event
